notes.title: Dev Diary #3 The Downtown
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Welcome to the third dev diary of Cyjin: The Cyborg Ninja. Today, we will be sharing more information about what you all could see yesterday in our official Kickstarter trailer. This video was focused on several stages you haven’t seen before; and one of them was the Downtown, a level that takes place in the city center. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/6d735e60e3a99459652589e8ba27d1b26c8a2895.jpg[/img]

As you know, the whole game is influenced by this Asian cyberpunk aesthetic that’s almost focused on Japan. To create this level, we looked for inspiration in the city of Tokyo. Starting from its current appearance, we tried to imagine how it could look in the future if it got transformed into a futuristic flying metropolis dwelled by robots.

Like in the real Tokyo, trains are part of everyone’s everyday life. They were used as backgrounds in the previous level, but there are many areas in this level where Cyjin must use them to reach other platforms or dodge attacks. These vehicles move super fast, so use them carefully to get through the level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/dac26bfcc43bff9601e575351613922443c33897.gif[/img]

Also, be careful when crossing the huge streets of the city center. The road is always full of traffic, so it’s easy to get hurt if you’re not careful enough. Doesn’t it feel a bit like Shinjuku?

In this level, you’ll also fight new monsters and the members of a criminal organization: the Ittan-Momen Yakuza. Downtown is under their control — and they’re not precisely kind to those who enter their territory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/bd72c4641eca40f531a2a24de493b591b77019f7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/f976efd23e6f340e6bfad20bf52e42e5f31269c0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/1ad0f49ff8066910a8e71d8466835660f9353e9d.jpg[/img]

But not everything is dangerous in the Downtown! You’ll have the opportunity to visit a beautiful Shinto shrine... that comes with a boss! As seen in the trailer, you know who awaits you at the end of the level: the Nine Tailed Fox! See it in full display.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/50be6bce67a399b3748b99ff8d99a9ba5c518c6a.png[/img]

Ultimately, we also added a new feature in our game: a definitive skill that allows Cyjin to throw a shuriken that tears everything in its path. The ultimate gauge fills up whenever you dash and damage an enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/220c55afd9b30e4ac51423182a3b8f5fbfbd70e9.gif[/img]

This is all for this dev diary! Our Kickstarter campaign is launching on June 9th and we still have a lot of work to do. If you like the game, please follow and support Cyijin: The Cyborg Ninja on Kickstarter:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aiyagamesandaaron/cyjin-the-cyborg-ninja-mouse-only-challenging-platformer

If you haven't watched the Kickstarter trailer yet, feel free to take a look at it:
[previewyoutube=fIoqwgiKXo4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dev Diary #2 The Urbanscape
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/6bf590506eec172545dd8a814f24a376b2f8b586.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Welcome to the second dev diary of [b]Cyjin: The Cyborg Ninja[/b]! We’re glad you’re here one more time to discover new things about our mouse-based precision platformer. And today, we’re showing you [b]the Urbanscape[/b], a level that takes place in the [b]futuristic residential area[/b] of the oriental city where Cyjin and his enemies live. 

This is how it looks now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/25e2d6957bc90a685c8054e70aeef0b106602cf0.jpg[/img]

This area is placed on the outskirts of the city center. Cyjin will fight his way on the buildings of oriental houses. The area is composed of many types of residential districts. One of them is a canal area, which is guarded by buildings and cherry blossom trees. These trees have no leaves but weird holo-sheets and long pink cables. Also, you will find out that savage crows love sitting on their right-angled branches. Nature can be a bit strange in future societies!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/6ccbf2bba17d22a588ab97221bcfbe479c39c48f.jpg[/img]

Most of the mechanics we introduced in this level are focused on a specific type of gameplay. We want players to [b]move as fast as possible[/b], and one of the elements we present here to achieve it is the [b]Reflector Wall[/b]: when dashing to it, Cyjin will bounce in the opposite direction. It’s a surface that helps players pick up more momentum and reach higher map areas. A unique bouncing action especially made for the Urbanscape.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/f0aba54ef5cbcede41f876826a5b63a0b81e11ff.gif[/img]

Aside from the Reflector Wall, you’ll also find something called [b]Cooldown Laser Wall[/b]. The laser wall will be active for a limited time, so players must find a way to go through these obstacles before they start working again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/20b6c7c1325e0effd42d4ceef97769fb989a79a9.gif[/img]

But these are not the only surprises that await you in this level. Here, [b]Cyjin will meet his rival again[/b] — but this time, there will be something different in him. [b]Kyōjin[/b] will challenge the cyborg ninja with powerful abilities to show him how strong he is becoming. If you want to defeat him this time, put in practice everything you learned about the Reflector Wall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/3db79ae97accdd955914257cd85245ef4b944b62.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/f27b95b2f5686c9f6f67ddbc4c64694dd1ff71d2.jpg[/img]

And this is all about the Urbanscape! Stay tuned for future updates. We are working as hard as we can for our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aiyagamesandaaron/cyjin-the-cyborg-ninja-mouse-only-challenging-platformer]Kickstarter campaign[/url]. Follow us and keep posted on its launch date.

And don’t forget to follow [i]Cyjin: The Cyborg Ninja[/i] on Steam and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550450/Cyjin_The_Cyborg_Ninja/

If you want to chat with us about the game, come [url=https://discord.gg/E3s329EF2h]join us on Discord[/url].

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 The Automation Factory
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are [b]Aiya Games[/b], developers of[b][i] Cyjin: The Cyborg Ninja[/i][/b], the fast-paced challenging platformer that you control with your mouse. We just completed the third stage of the game, and we couldn’t wait to share our progress with you, so here we are -- this is the very first entry of our dev diary! Today we want to give you a sneak peek at the [b]second level of the game[/b]: the [b]Automation Factory[/b].

The concept of this level is an intricate maze of [b]narrow corridors and moving obstacles[/b]. One of these obstacles is a moving wall: you have limited time to dash through deadly lasers while you are on these walls. A true ninja will be able to go through these narrow challenges. Can you do it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/bd96b4a4fcec7c07271283d7fe4997da287efed1.gif[/img]

While you navigate through this area, you will find [b]many enemies blocking your advance[/b]. There are several types of them, like the one which can shoot bullets that bounce on the walls (thus killing you with their ricocheting) or an enemy that literally stops your progress in its tracks by acting like a wall. All of them are [b]inspired by supernatural creatures and spirits called ‘yōkai’[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/8d5ec17fd2fd63a43d4ba9d079b4ccdb6edf2d14.jpg[/img]

The yōkai came from Japanese mythology. They’re a very diverse group of monsters that, most of the time, were said to cause misfortune and harm. Sometimes they look like humans and animals ([i]kitsune, tengu, kappa[/i]), or everyday objects ([i]tsukumogami[/i]); but others don’t have a discernible shape. One of the first official compilations of yōkai, which is very famous among folklorists, was written by the artist Toriyama Sekien in 1779: it was called [i]Konjaku Gazu Zoku Hyakki[/i] (in English, [i]The Illustrated One Hundred Demons from the Present and the Past[/i]). We recommend you to search it and take a look at his beautiful representations!

The boss of the Automation Factory is a [b][i]kamaitachi[/i][/b], an ermine-like yōkai that [b]has razor-sharp claws and spins at incredibly high speed[/b]. Like how the folklore is told, this boss can change his face during the fight -- and also his skills and abilities accordingly. Each face and form has its own sets of powers. This is certainly not a foe to take lightly -- reading how it changes its face is the key strategy of this boss fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39886556/84eb1aee863fe69b0034fd98152a2dd9ed67d827.png[/img]

Last but not least, during your journey inside this maze-like factory [b]you will face your rival[/b]: another ninja called [b]Kyojin[/b]... And it won't be a friendly encounter. His movements are as fast and precise as Cyjin's, so don't let your guard down. We'll tell you more about him in a future dev diary!

This is all about level two for now!! Stay tuned for more updates and info on the game’s development. We are also getting ready to launch our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aiyagamesandaaron/cyjin-the-cyborg-ninja-mouse-only-challenging-platformer][b]Kickstarter campaign[/b][/url]. Follow us and keep posted on its progress.

And don’t forget to follow [i]Cyjin: The Cyborg Ninja[/i] on Steam and [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550450/Cyjin_The_Cyborg_Ninja/

Also, join our brand new Discord server for the last news and chats:
https://discord.gg/GRq29PMBkv

We hope to see you soon! Thank you so much for your support.
